population.primary_eligibility: ground-truth attack onset observable in raw run tensor

reuse.new_neural_inference: only the 75 onset-observed/right-censored-termination runs missing from R1

time_to_response.alarm_event: q=2 confirmation at SECOND positive decision
time_to_response.event_fraction: descriptive observed-response-by-end fraction; not interpreted as permanent failure rate
time_to_response.observation_end_fully_observed: min(last available decision, observed attack termination)
time_to_response.observation_end_right_censored_terminati: last available decision; attack is still active there
time_to_response.onset: first raw per-epoch y_attack==1; scheduled campaign attack_start_tick not used
time_to_response.primary_median: first epoch with KM response CDF >= 0.50
time_to_response.primary_p95: first epoch with KM response CDF >= 0.95; NR if not estimable
time_to_response.structured_event: first exact 16-router role set at or after successful q=2 alarm
